test_vectors.vectors: Identity targets for every constructor; forward, backward and shared aliases; nonzero and aliased roots; fully collapsed targets; unchanged schema metadata, declaration order and definitions; repeated read-only access.
Case-sensitive ASCII, composed and decomposed Unicode, embedded NUL, literal pointer-like and URL-like names; missing names and differently spelled names return UnsupportedSchemaFeature.

Unreachable unknown references, self aliases and mutual alias cycles; empty graphs and names, duplicate definitions and properties, reversed scalar bounds, invalid root/property/array/definition IDs including u32::MAX; SchemaCompile source, zero offset, schema ID and available field context.

Node and definition counts at and above limits, zero budgets, every name category at the UTF-8 byte boundary and one byte above, empty schema/property names, unreachable oversized names, pattern and format strings excluded from name budgets.

Chains of lengths 1, 2 and 7 in both traversal orders at exact, one-below and zero limits; cached suffixes; unreachable over-budget chains; 32 shared aliases without global accumulation; constructor edges reset hop counts.

Object and array self loops, mutual object/array recursion through aliases, unreachable cycles, unused definitions, diamonds, repeated targets, cycles in later properties, optional fields and arrays with maximum zero items.
All 512 directed three-node graphs with each of the three roots, compared with an independent transitive-closure oracle.

8192-alias chains in both traversal orders; 12000-edge structural chains with and without a back edge; deterministic Vec capacity overflow; zero and u32::MAX counts; unrepresentable counts on 64-bit targets; invalid accessor IDs without mutation.
